status: implemented and run; constants fixed in scripts/run_company_disjoint_benchmark.py before execution
claim_unit: one revenue-guidance claim (company, cutoff date, target period)
training_filter: company fold != test fold AND outcome date < January 1 of the test year
features: number of prior outcomes public before cutoff
calibration: none in the primary benchmark; temperature scaling on internal company-disjoint folds in the decision-layer sensitivity

uncertainty.claim_level: average each claim's correctness over the five fold seeds, then bootstrap claims
uncertainty.ensemble: average the five fold-seed probability vectors per claim, then paired bootstrap over claims
uncertainty.significance: two-sided sign-flip permutation test over claim-level differences; per-seed McNemar reported as a secondary test

sensitivity.verified_only: restrict evaluation to test claims whose outcome label is xbrl_search, xbrl_verified, or xbrl_override (n=227); text_only and text_only_mismatch labels excluded
sensitivity.reason: the 46 excluded claims have text-only outcome labels and can bias accuracy/selective estimates

decision_layer.state: three-way probability vector from the evidence model
decision_layer.policy: Bayes action minimizing expected asymmetric loss
decision_layer.primary_comparison: planner minus always-answer decision loss; planner regret relative to the best fixed policy across the loss grid
